name: Feature Request
description: Suggest an idea or enhancement for SecureMail
labels: ["enhancement"]
body:
  - type: textarea
    id: proposal
    attributes:
      label: Feature Proposal
      description: What feature or enhancement would you like to see?
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: motivation
    attributes:
      label: Business / User Motivation
      description: Why is this feature needed and what problem does it solve?
